name: scratch: restore passPurchases flag to ON

steps.expression: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('[data-testid=flag-state-passPurchases]'); if (s && s.getAttribute('data-on') === '1') return 'already-on'; const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=flag-toggle-passPurchases]'); if (!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
